title: Jedlik, Ganz, and the Electrification of Cities
grammar: Formal postpositions of technical means and agency (révén, útján, segítségével)
goal: I can explain Ányos Jedlik's dynamo principle and the 1885 ZBD transformer invented by Károly Zipernowsky, Miksa Déri, and Ottó Bláthy at the Ganz Works.
I can use formal postpositions of means (révén, útján, segítségével, által) with possessive or unmarked noun phrases.
I can discuss electrical engineering and industrial patents in B2 Hungarian.
